Very good doctor for your pet. Highly recommend. He cured my cat, made good injections, the cat feels very well now. Not as some other clinics here, he will not try to sell you overpriced pet tablets or liquids and the price for the treatment in this clinic is very fair.

Please, notice, the doctor doesn't speak English, but you can use translation app easily. The clinic is  very small and simple, but the doctor is a real pro. I wish him much luck and success!

The vet was incompetent, lacked knowledge, made a wrong diagnosis, and I wasted over a month and money. My cat's condition didn't improve. I told the vet that the diagnosis was incorrect, saying it was mange. They even had a misconception that the sulfur smell was fading after the first visit, even though the cat's condition had worsened. They never properly examined the cat's skin, were nervous, careless, and didn't pay attention to the animal. In short, I took the cat to another vet, and within less than a month, the cat's condition gradually improved. He didnt know what hes doing. Misdiagnosed my cat for mange and mistreated him for a month and a half only to get worse and he never took time to actually look and analyze anything. He was fidgeting poking needle into my cat just to pull back because he didnt calculate it well, double jabbed and all. Very poor handling plus misdiagnosis. If you love your pets, dont bring them here. I tried to tell the guy that his method wasnt working and he probably misdiagnosed, he even argued and told me to come for the 4th time to get 3more jabs, my cat already took 9 shots by the time. Gross, he isnt knowledgeable AT ALL! if he doesnt even know that a cat got fungus (Dermatophytosis) not Mange. If he cant understand and diagnose a simple common skin condition he will fail in every other aspect as a vet.
I took my cat to get spayed. It was a good job! My cat is recovering well now. The vet was kind and friendly. The price wasn't expensive, but you need to call to make an appointment.

Great, I recommend it. It's a simple, homemade remedy, but it really works.
My cat recovered completely.
